tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page and main content ground. Everything else layers on it.

tokens.name: layer-01
tokens.usage: Tiles, stat blocks, input fields, the sidebar organisation block, the agreement preview backdrop.

tokens.name: layer-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on nav items, list rows, ghost buttons and tiles.

tokens.name: layer-selected
tokens.usage: Selected nav item and table header row. Pair with the 3px interactive rule on nav.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines between rows, sections and cards. Never a drop shadow instead.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Bottom rule of inputs, content switcher dividers, toggle off track.

tokens.name: border-inverse
tokens.usage: Content switcher outline, selected tile outline, heading rules above a list.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on background and layer-01.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, labels and captions on background and layer-01 (7.6:1 light, 9.9:1 dark on background).

tokens.name: text-helper
tokens.usage: Placeholder and helper text only, on background and layer-01. Never for anything a person must read to finish a task.

tokens.name: text-on-color
tokens.usage: Text and icons on interactive, button-secondary, support-error and support-success fills.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on layer-inverse (toasts).

tokens.name: layer-inverse
tokens.usage: Toast notifications. The only high-contrast surface in the product.

tokens.name: interactive
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active nav rule, progress fill, selected week, focus ring in light. The one accent: never a card background or eyebrow colour.

tokens.name: interactive-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on primary buttons and tertiary buttons.

tokens.name: interactive-active
tokens.usage: Pressed primary button.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links and ghost button labels on background and layer-01.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered links.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, inset by 2px, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: button-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill (Back, Cancel, Add). White text on it.

tokens.name: button-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered secondary button.

tokens.name: button-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled button fill, e.g. Save project before both safety checks are ticked.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Label on button-disabled and disabled fields. Exempt from contrast rules.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Info notifications, the current week, the privacy promise and the team agreement quote.

tokens.name: support-info
tokens.usage: Left rule and icon of info notifications on highlight.

tokens.name: support-success
tokens.usage: Completed module icons, toggle on track, success notification rule. Always paired with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: support-success-inverse
tokens.usage: Toast rule and check icon on layer-inverse (3:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: support-success-bg
tokens.usage: Success notification ground (Saved, Invitations sent).

tokens.name: support-error
tokens.usage: Field errors, the error outline on inputs, destructive actions.

tokens.name: support-warning
tokens.usage: Warning icons only, with dark text beside them. Never text colour.

tokens.name: tag-gray-bg
tokens.usage: Neutral tags: Draft, Not started, member names.

tokens.name: tag-gray-text
tokens.usage: Text on tag-gray-bg.

tokens.name: tag-blue-bg
tokens.usage: State tags that mean current or active: Active, Now, In progress, Week 4.

tokens.name: tag-blue-text
tokens.usage: Text on tag-blue-bg.

tokens.name: tag-green-bg
tokens.usage: State tags that mean finished: Completed, Done, Saved, Output reviewed.

tokens.name: tag-green-text
tokens.usage: Text on tag-green-bg.

tokens.name: tag-purple-bg
tokens.usage: The Grow in my role track tag only.

tokens.name: tag-purple-text
tokens.usage: Text on tag-purple-bg.

tokens.name: avatar-manager
tokens.usage: Manager avatar fill. Text on it is avatar-ink.

tokens.name: avatar-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on avatar-manager (Blue 100 navy from the brand palette).

tokens.name: chart-before
tokens.usage: The before bar in before and after comparisons. Always labelled with its value.

tokens.name: chart-after
tokens.usage: The after bar in before and after comparisons.

styles.name: display-01
styles.usage: One per page at most: the prototype guide hero.

styles.name: display-02
styles.sample: Priya invited you to Lead the Way
styles.usage: Marketing and invitation heroes; headline numbers such as 40 min saved.

styles.name: display-03
styles.sample: Make learning part of the working week
styles.usage: Setup flow titles, landing section heads, stat numbers.

styles.name: heading-02
styles.usage: Section heroes and case study titles.

styles.name: heading-04
styles.usage: Form group titles and list headings.

styles.name: body-01
styles.sample: One hour of your working week is protected for practical AI learning.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs under page titles, marketing body.

styles.name: body-02
styles.usage: The UI default: rows, buttons, form values.

styles.name: body-emphasis
styles.usage: Nav items, the lead words of a notification, selected tabs.

styles.name: label-01
styles.usage: Field labels, captions, helper and error text, tags.

tokens.name: spacing-01
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles in a tile grid and between tag rows.

tokens.name: spacing-02
tokens.usage: Label to helper text; icon nudges.

tokens.name: spacing-03
tokens.usage: Label to field, icon to text, tags in a row.

tokens.name: spacing-04
tokens.usage: Icon to text in notifications and nav items.

tokens.name: spacing-05
tokens.usage: Tile and notification padding, button horizontal padding, side nav inset.

tokens.name: spacing-06
tokens.usage: Between form fields in a group; section padding inside tiles.

tokens.name: spacing-07
tokens.usage: Main content padding and the gap between page sections.

tokens.name: spacing-09
tokens.usage: Gap between editor and aside columns; large hero padding.

tokens.name: spacing-10
tokens.usage: Setup flow side padding and landing section rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, tiles, inputs, modals, cards, avatars. The flat-square look is the brand.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Tags only, including dismissible tags.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Status icons, toggle knob and the radio dot.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only things that float above the page: the account menu, toasts, modals.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, nav items, table row actions.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, medium buttons, content switcher.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Default buttons, tabs, table rows, mobile touch targets.

tokens.name: size-control-xl
tokens.usage: Full-width footer buttons in setup flows and modals.

tokens.name: size-sidenav
tokens.usage: Default expanded sidebar width. Drag range 200px to 400px.

tokens.name: size-sidenav-rail
tokens.usage: Collapsed sidebar rail: icons, logo and avatars only.
